purpose: Held-out generalisation probe for the Product Owner router. None of the probes appear in benchmark/router/fixtures.json or benchmark/router/differential_corpus.json, so a pass there measures whether the semantic patterns match intent rather than remembered wording. Keep the probes out of both files. The guards are the opposite by design: they restate inputs the fixtures already pin, so a routing change that breaks an excluded term or the create-a-task-to-write-a-PRD precedence shows up here as well as there.
